Q: Intellij IDEA project build never completing A:

Try File -> Invalidate Caches.. -> Invalidate and Restart

Once the IDE restarts and completes indexing, try building again

Q: Rust and C++ FFI: orchestrating destructors/drops of struct fields A:

A simple solution is to extract the code in MyStruct::drop() to another exported function, and call it from MyStruct::drop() and from MyStruct::~MyStruct().

Q: How can I best optimize a Bigquery SQL by appending completely redundant filters to the query? A:

I have another, related. A CTE1 is relatively swift at 2.53 seconds to crack 80,000 rows of (long) JSON and return about 20 or so variables. But if I make up a completely irrelevant CTE2 and do a cross-join of CTE1 and CTE2 then I can get elapsed time down to 1.35 seconds.

It seems that when presented with a relatively complex query then BigQuery pulls out the "big guns", whereas when its has small query (<100MB) that can be handled in one go then it takes a simpler path.

Unclear whether to believe an LLM analysis but it reckoned that the existence of the second CTE2 led the planner to do a parallel read of the materialized view in CTE1, whereas with just the CTE1 it did a serialized read.

Q: Confused about swing asynchronous update A:

The way you are implementing is mostly correct. i.e. it will completely suffice in the normal contexts.

Why it is OK:

buttons ActionListeners will be invoked via EDT in all normal cases.

Case closed. (Or is it!?)

Why it is not even 99% OK

Someone could use Reflection, get all of button's ActionListeners, then call them from ANY Thread. In that (rather extremely rare) case your code might corrupt some models and cause strange effects.

How to upgrade it to 99%

Simply wrap everything in the actionPerformed(e) method into either SwingUtilities.invokeLater() or SwingUtilities.invokeAndWait(), depending on your needs..

Why not even that is 100% correct

There are lots of methods that influence the execution of JVM applications, be it at compile time (.java to .class), loading of the .class files, executing the .class file bytecode.

Most bigger frameworks, especially the JPA (Java Persistence API) ones, AOP (Aspect Oriented Programming), some Test suites (automated testing) manipulate your code code in one of these steps. So even calling SwingUtilities.invodeXXX() in your code could be circumvened.

Also, under certain OSs, there exist the possibilities to 'call methods' (i.e. 'execute code') from other application's Threads, or even accessing memory as another application. Then there's also the option to load custom .dll/.so files instead of the native (Java) ones, so anything based on 'external' JNI calls could be manipulated, too.

These are cases that you usually do NOT have to consider. Plus working out those will cost a lot of time. - But it's always good to keep that in your head, too, for cases where this might actually pose a problem to be considered.

Q: PHP shorthand for isset && truthy A:

I agree empty() is not very clear.

To make your solution work for me, I have to use == instead of ===, because it doesn't have to BE true, it should be "truthy" / convert to true.

I think it is clearer than empty(), but i still have to think about the intention, when I read it.

What I am looking for is something that reads as easy as (bool) $_POST['verylongname'] but set to false, if 'verylongname' does not exist in $_POST instead of a warning.
